contents: Where the colony's units were when they were killed: near its own buildings, near an enemy's buildings, or in open ground between colonies. Losses at home mean the colony was being attacked; losses at an enemy colony mean it was attacking. Ground close to both colonies counts as home.
Choose Random to select a soundtrack at each match start.
